en: A multiview color postcard featuring various landmarks of the city of Pécs. The front shows several photographs bordered in red and yellow: the Pécs Cathedral with its four towers, a domed mosque, historical buildings and a public square with statues, city panoramas with tiled rooftops, a section of medieval walls and towers, a statue on a balcony, and an interior church mosaic of Christ and saints. The top of the front side has the large title "PÉCS". The reverse side has standard postcard layout with address lines, stamp boxes, barcodes, and multilingual greetings from Pécs, along with the logo and details of the publisher Ars Una Studio from Budapest, Hungary.
